user_goal: Create and manage a simple task list.
user_story: As a first-time user, I want to add, complete, and delete tasks so that I can manage a short list.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given non-empty text, when the user adds a task, then the task appears in the list.
Given blank text, when the user adds a task, then the task is rejected.
Given an existing task, when the user marks it complete, then its completed state changes.
Given an existing task, when the user deletes it, then it no longer appears.

security_privacy_considerations: local-only data has no authentication boundary
